philosophy.p1: Virtuous Vogue begins with the woman, not the trend. Before we talk about a single garment, we talk about your life: the rooms you walk into, the work you do, the way you want to be met.
philosophy.p2: You give what you wear relevance. What you wear does not give you relevance. Our role is to help you see your own style clearly, then to make dressing for it simple.
philosophy.quote: Fashion is the language. Identity is the message. Style is how you communicate it.

colour.title: Explore colours that may work beautifully with you.
colour.intro: An optional, photo-assisted preview of undertone tendency and contrast. It is a starting point, not a professional colour analysis.
tips: Photograph yourself in natural, indirect daylight
Minimal or no makeup where possible
A neutral background and bare neckline area, shoulders covered
colour.consentBody: Your photo is processed to estimate skin undertone and contrast, then kept privately in your account only if you choose to save it. It is never used to train models. You can delete it at any time.

services.title: Styling, considered.
services.intro: Six ways to work together, from a single clarifying conversation to an ongoing private relationship. In person in Douala, or virtually from anywhere.

how.title: Choose
how.body: Pick the consultation that matches where you are. If you're unsure, ask; we'll tell you plainly.

how.title: Prepare
how.body: A short form and, if you like, your Style Compass and Closet Remix results give the stylist context.

how.title: Meet

how.title: Receive
how.body: Notes, palettes and lookbooks land in your Style Passport, where they stay.
